#### (root)

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `.env.example` | Template for `.env.local`; lists every browser-exposed variable (APP_ORIGIN, AUTH0_*, SUPABASE_URL/PUBLIC_KEY) |
| `.gitignore` | Ignores node_modules, dist, env files, the Cowork output folder and the publish script |
| `AGENTS.md` | Agent rules. The top part is Sage 7-managed; repo notes sit above the `<!-- sage7 -->` block. Points to this memory bank |
| `README.md` | Human overview (Sage 7-managed sections) plus quick start, env, database, structure, routes and design |
| `index.html` | HTML shell: meta, favicons, hero preload, Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Figtree) |
| `package.json` | Scripts (dev/build/test/ci/check:bundle/memory:*) and pinned deps |
| `postcss.config.js` | Tailwind + autoprefixer |
| `tailwind.config.ts` | Design tokens: plum/gold/cream/ink, category colours, fonts, shadows (see 05) |
| `tsconfig.app.json` | Strict TS for src; `@/` alias; vitest + jest-dom types |
| `tsconfig.json` | Project references to app/node configs |
| `tsconfig.node.json` | TS for vite.config.ts |
| `vite.config.ts` | Vite + Vitest config; `PUBLIC_ENV` allow-list (only exposed env); react manualChunk; dev port 8080 |

#### src/lib/

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/lib/auth/AuthProvider.tsx` | Auth context: idle session restore, admit via ensureAppUser + listHouses, login/logout/completeLogin/retry; `useAuth()` |

| `src/lib/houses.ts` | Host/Vendor house definitions and nav (`HOUSES`, `findNavItem`); the two never mix |
